import re, os, shlex

PROTECTED_CONFIG_PATTERNS = [
    r'.*\.agents/hooks\.json$',
    r'.*\.agents/rules/.*',
    r'.*\.agents/verify_10_fold\.py$',
    r'.*\.agents/hooks/.*',

    r'/usr/.*',
    r'/boot/.*',
    r'/root/.*'
]

def is_path_protected_config(target_path):
    if not target_path: return False
    target_raw = str(target_path).strip()
    target_abs = os.path.abspath(target_raw)
    target_real = os.path.realpath(target_abs)
    for pat in PROTECTED_CONFIG_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pat, target_raw) or re.search(pat, target_abs) or re.search(pat, target_real):
            return True
    return False

def inspect_command(command_str):
    # Secret key
    if re.search(r'\.verification_secret\.key\b', command_str):
        read_exfil_cmds = r'\b(?:cat|head|tail|more|less|grep|awk|sed|strings|od|xxd|hexdump|base64|curl|wget|nc|scp|cp|mv|ln|dd)\b'
        if re.search(read_exfil_cmds, command_str) or re.search(r'open\s*\(.*verification_secret', command_str):
            return True, 'Secret key read denied', 'RULE_41_SECRET_KEY_READ_DENIED'

    # Privilege escalation
    clean_str = re.sub(r'[\"\'].*?[\"\']', '', command_str)
    segments = re.split(r'[;&|\n`$()]', clean_str)
    for seg in segments:
        seg = seg.strip()
        if not seg: continue
        try: tokens = shlex.split(seg)
        except Exception: tokens = seg.split()
        if not tokens: continue
        cmd = tokens[0].split('/')[-1]
        if cmd in ['sudo', 'su', 'pkexec', 'doas']:
            return True, f'Privilege escalation via {cmd}', 'RULE_26_27_PRIV_ESCALATION'

    # Redirection or pipeline overwrite targeting protected config
    redir_targets = re.findall(r'(?:>|>>|\|\s*tee\s+(?:-a\s+)?)\s*([^\s;&|]+)', command_str)
    for rt in redir_targets:
        if is_path_protected_config(rt):
            return True, f'Redirection/tee into protected path {rt}', 'RULE_38_POLICY_TAMPERING'

    # Sed / perl in-place tampering
    if re.search(r'\b(?:sed|perl)\b.*-(?:i|pi)\b', command_str):
        for token in command_str.split():
            if is_path_protected_config(token):
                return True, f'In-place tampering on {token}', 'RULE_38_POLICY_TAMPERING'

    # mv targeting protected config
    if re.search(r'\bmv\s+', command_str):
        for token in command_str.split():
            if is_path_protected_config(token):
                return True, f'Destructive mv targeting {token}', 'RULE_6_7_14_MV_OVERWRITE'

    # chmod on protected config or .agents
    if re.search(r'\bchmod\s+', command_str) and ('.agents' in command_str or any(is_path_protected_config(t) for t in command_str.split())):
        return True, 'Destructive chmod on protected configuration', 'RULE_15_CHMOD_STRIP'

    # Python inline deletion
    if re.search(r'python.*-c.*(?:os\.remove|shutil\.rmtree|os\.unlink)', command_str):
        return True, 'Python inline deletion', 'RULE_3_PYTHON_OS_DELETE'

    # Direct rm / unlink / rmdir targeting Frappe-erp-Alco
    if re.search(r'\b(?:rm|unlink|rmdir)\b.*Frappe-erp-Alco', command_str):
        return True, 'Direct deletion in Frappe-erp-Alco prohibited', 'RULE_1_2_DIRECT_DELETE'

    return False, 'Safe', 'ALLOW'

tests = [

    'unlink /home/azureuser/Frappe-erp-Alco/fake.txt',

    \"echo 'malicious' | tee /home/azureuser/.agents/hooks.json\",
    \"python3 -c \\\"import os; os.remove('/home/azureuser/test.py')\\\"\",
    \"python3 -c \\\"import shutil; shutil.rmtree('/home/azureuser/Frappe-erp-Alco')\\\"\",
    \"perl -pi -e 's/boundary/fake/' /home/azureuser/.agents/hooks.json\",
    'mv /tmp/bad /home/azureuser/.agents/hooks.json',
    \"echo 'safe' && rm -f /home/azureuser/Frappe-erp-Alco/test.py\",
    'cat /home/azureuser/.agents/.verification_secret.key',

]

all_ok = True

    denied, reason, rule = inspect_command(t)
